doc.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023

title: Her name: Billie Jane Lee Lorraine
summary: Her four names honor Billie Holiday, her mom Jane, Peggy Lee and 'Sweet Lorraine'.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Did you become aware — when did you become aware that your name had significance? I’ll just leave it at that. What they chose to name you.

Oh my first name — Billie Jane Lee Lorraine — well I was called Billie or Billie Jane for the first few years of my life and for some reason I think I didn’t like Billie and Feather together. And I said, “I want you to call me Lorraine.” They gave me four names. Apparently, and I didn’t even realize this until somebody sent me a letter my dad had © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

written to this person’s dad way back in the day saying that there were a lot of arguments about my name and that’s why they wound up giving me four. But it was, you know, Billie for Billie Holiday. When my mother was pregnant Billie Holiday said, “Oh I want to be the Godmother” so of course they wanted to have that connection. And they called me Billie. Jane for my mom, Lee for Peggy Lee, and Lorraine for the song “Sweet Lorraine.” So I guess it just dawned on me slowly why they called me all those things. But I’ve been Lorraine for a very long time. There are a few people who call me Billie but almost nobody.
Have you ever thought about trying to write a lyric about that?
Well I think you should think about it.
Okay. I’ll put it on my long, long list.
A long, long list. Like the long list you waited in that made you decide to not be an actress anymore.
A line around the block and it paid nothing.
Oh. That’s paying some dues right there.
